rationale: RENDERS for Go has ONE honest construct: a symbol whose body EXECUTES an `html/template`, where the template is a PUBLISHED symbol (the contract: source = the rendering symbol, target = the rendered component; here the template is the component). The `calls` row for the Execute invocation is a DIFFERENT and also-true fact, so this fixture forbids nothing about `calls` — the render row is additive, not a relabel. THE FIRES: `Handler -> pageTemplate` (a package-level template var constructed by `template.Must(template.New("page").Parse(...))`) and `Handler -> indexTemplate` (a template SET; `ExecuteTemplate(w, "index", ...)` names the rendered sub-template, and that NAME rides in `metadata.templateName`, never as the edge target — a name string would let the arbiter bind an unrelated declaration, the false-edge direction this programme refuses). THE FORBIDS ARE EACH A MEASURED IMPOSTOR CLASS, not decoration: (1) `constructedOnly` — a template that is never executed; construction is not a render. (2) `localRender` — a LOCAL template var; Go locals are not symbols (LocalsAreNotSymbols). (3) `paramsOnly` — a template PARAMETER, also not a published symbol. (4) `valueReceiver` — an expression receiver (a call result), not a symbol. (5) `textOnlyPage` — `text/template`, the measured impostor class (151 corpus files, almost all code generators); the fixture aliases it as a SECOND import and the constructor qualifier is resolved against the html/template import's OWN local name (`template`), so the alias cannot smuggle a row in. (6) `cmdRunner` — a package-level value whose `Execute` method is not a template execution. (7) `Handler -> Execute` and `Handler -> index` and `Handler -> page` — the method name, the sub-template name and the template's own name are NOT the rendered component; the published template SYMBOL is. (8) THE LINE CONVENTION: `Handler`'s first call is written with the selector WRAPPED (`pageTemplate.` on one line, `Execute(w, nil)` on the next), so the row's line is the OPERAND's line — the name-bearing node's line (M59.A7) — and the Execute token's line is forbidden. The expected line numbers were read off the fixture source (72 = `pageTemplate.`, 74 = `indexTemplate`) before the run.

forbidRelationships.note: pre-fix shape: the Execute TOKEN's line; the rendered symbol's name is written on 72
